policy.permanentD0: Do not re-analyze proven D0 mechanisms on a schedule. Preserve the exact immutable identity; new deployments/dependencies and evidence corrections are separate work.
policy.monthly: Full source and authority restudy for every other review and all unresolved position dependencies. A failed attempt cannot advance reviewedAt.

checklist.check: Confirm chain ID, exact deployment, version and scope; resolve proxies and factory provenance.
Inspect source matched to runtime, all inherited/reachable authority code and implementation replacement paths.
Trace live owner, admin, role members, councils, issuers and external controllers to their complete authority graph.
Check timelocks, bypasses, veto, emergency actions and execution paths.
Check custody, balances, freezes, pauses, issuance, withdrawals and offchain redemption controls.
Resolve token, chain, oracle, hook, vault, strategy, bridge and backing dependencies; preserve unknowns.

chain: Use the current project contract addresses and L2BEAT governance/exit sections, including council appointment, foundation/operator bypass and upgrade delay. Ethereum L1 is the D0 reference baseline.
asset: Follow the actual token implementation and reachable controllers; never inherit an application rating by brand or ticker. Include issuer backing/redemption and bridge origin where material.
protocol: Separate immutable core from selected hooks/oracles/vaults and upgradeable periphery. Review all reachable privileged custody/exit paths for the recorded deployment.
